'''Justor Ferral''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] that had earned the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was dispatched to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. He used a floating battle disk in battle.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
